gate: GEO source-lineage and metadata-only reconciliation for Harmange 2023 and Shaffer 2017
permitted_operations: verify exact frozen SHA-256 of metadata files
parse GEO Series and Sample metadata fields only
record sample accessions, titles, source names, characteristics, and declared relations
read only the first header row of Harmange cell metadata TSV
record explicit subseries/BioProject/SRA relations when declared in GEO metadata
forbidden_operations: read cell-level metadata rows beyond the header
select cohorts based on result values
construct chi_bio, Chi_bio, or Bio Chi
scientific_effect: NONE; source lineage and reproducibility qualification only
